nodes.label: Backtest Harness (edge-proving)
nodes.rationale: Replays EntrySignals through the REAL RiskManager sizing gate and the same deterministic exit lifecycle the live watchdog runs, so tuning KELLY/vol/stops here maps 1:1 to production. Not replayed: the signal->Claude step.

nodes.label: Data-subscription Decision Gate
nodes.rationale: Turns 'don't pay for data before you can measure it helps' into a mechanical gate: joins ledger signal-attribution P&L to candidate subscriptions and returns SUBSCRIBE / KEEP MEASURING / INSUFFICIENT DATA.

nodes.label: Signal Attribution / Reflection Loop
nodes.rationale: Adopted cheaply from TradingAgents' reflection/memory loop: reconstructs closed round-trips from the ledger, scores each entry-signal source by realized win-rate + avg P&L, and injects a terse Track-record block into the decision prompt.

nodes.label: TradingAgents Review (what to adopt/reject)
nodes.rationale: Adopted: technical analyst signals, internal bull/bear reasoning in one prompt, reflection/attribution loop. Rejected: LangGraph multi-call orchestration, LLM-debated risk (would weaken the deterministic safety core), per-ticker multi-agent fan-out (token cost).

nodes.label: Quiver Paid-tier Shared Client + Datasets
nodes.rationale: One per-cycle shared Quiver client (Bearer auth, 429 backoff, path-keyed cache). HAVE: congress/senate/house trading, offexchange, govcontracts, lobbying, flights. NEED UPGRADE (403): wallstreetbets, insiders (free via Finnhub+EDGAR anyway), 13F, twitter.

nodes.label: Account P&L Tracker (Alpaca truth)
nodes.rationale: The ledger structurally undercounts because exchange-side bracket auto-fills never pass through our code, so the honest are-we-up view is sourced from the Alpaca account: total_return = equity - base_value - net_cashflows.

nodes.label: Watchdog CRITICAL Alerting
nodes.rationale: Pages a human on every watchdog CRITICAL (naked position after a failed close) and the latched equity-floor halt via Gmail SMTP + optional webhook. Fails open (never raises into the safety loop) and is throttled per event key.

nodes.label: Earnings-blackout Guard
nodes.rationale: Rejects new buys within N days of a report (gap risk dwarfs the stop); sells/exits are never blacked out. Fails open on unknown earnings dates.
